usage: sot-validator audit verify [-h] --curation-db CURATION_DB [--anchor ANCHOR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --curation-db CURATION_DB
                        Curation SQLite database to verify (opened read-only).
  --anchor ANCHOR       External anchor COUNT:HASH, as printed by `audit head`, the chain must
                        still match.
